extraFacts.fact: Ferryl was founded in Sweden in 1955.

faqs.q: What is the Ferryl Pump Unit for the Wire Rope Lubricator?
faqs.a: The Ferryl Pump Unit is an air-powered, high-pressure grease pump mounted on a pneumatic ram press and wheeled trolley. It feeds the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator a steady flow of grease straight from the drum. Ferryl developed it to get the most from the lubricator.

faqs.q: Which part number does the Ferryl Pump Unit have?
faqs.a: The Ferryl Pump Unit is supplied as a single item, an air-operated pump with pneumatic ram press, part number IH-FRY-PUMP. It is sold separately from the lubricator. Confirm the grease drum size and your air supply with us before ordering.

faqs.q: How does the Ferryl Pump Unit differ from the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator?
faqs.a: The Pump Unit only supplies grease; the [Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator](/p/ferryl-wire-rope-lubricator) is the chamber clamped round the wire that forces grease into the core. The lubricator works with many grease pumps, but Ferryl developed the Pump Unit to feed it a steady, controlled flow.

faqs.q: When should the Ferryl Pump Unit be chosen to feed the lubricator?
faqs.a: Choose the Pump Unit when you want the full performance Ferryl publishes for the lubricator. Ferryl states its figures of 400 bar, 4.5 kg/min and 40 m/min were measured with this pump. Other pumps and greases may give different results.

faqs.q: What performance figures were measured with the Ferryl Pump Unit?
faqs.a: Ferryl's published lubricator figures, 400 bar pressure, 4.5 kg/min grease output and 40 m/min lubrication speed, were measured with this Pump Unit. They are maker figures for the lubricator running on the pump. Ferryl does not publish a separate pressure ratio for the pump, so we do not quote one.

faqs.q: Which grease and drive does the Ferryl Pump Unit use?
faqs.a: The Pump Unit runs on compressed air from the ship's supply and pumps grease. It is designed for [Ferryl 202 Standard grease](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease). A pneumatic ram press follows the grease down the drum and pushes stiff grease into the pump intake, so the pump is never starved.

faqs.q: Does the Ferryl Pump Unit have a published standard or approval?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for the Pump Unit. The documents that exist are the Ferryl product information, and we can supply further documents on request. Air supply, drum size and connections should be confirmed with us before you order.

faqs.q: Which products does the Ferryl Pump Unit work with?
faqs.a: The Pump Unit feeds the [Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator](/p/ferryl-wire-rope-lubricator) and is designed for [Ferryl 202 Standard grease](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease). For other drum pumps, see our [grease and oil barrel pumps](/c/lubrication-barrel-pumps) and the guide to [drum pumps and manual lubricators](/blog/grease-and-oil-drum-pumps-and-manual-lubricators).

faqs.q: How is the Ferryl Pump Unit set up and operated?
faqs.a: Connect the Pump Unit to the ship's compressed-air supply and place the ram press on the grease drum; the press follows the grease down as the pump draws. It has simple controls and a wheeled frame for moving round the deck. Ferryl does not publish an operating pressure for the pump here.

faqs.q: Where is the Ferryl Pump Unit used?
faqs.a: The Ferryl Pump Unit is used on deck wherever the Wire Rope Lubricator is greasing mooring, towing, crane, hoist, luffing or ramp wires. It runs from the ship's compressed-air supply and its wheeled frame lets crews move it round the deck.

faqs.q: Who makes the Ferryl Pump Unit and where is it made?
faqs.a: The Ferryl Pump Unit is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Country of origin is Germany. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: Is the Ferryl Pump Unit for Wire Rope Lubricator available in stock?
faqs.a: We keep the Ferryl Pump Unit for Wire Rope Lubricator in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address, and we confirm the quote. Also tell us your compressed-air supply. [Contact us](/contact) with any questions.

faqs.q: What is the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator?
faqs.a: The Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator is an anodised aluminium pressure chamber clamped round a wire rope. The wire runs through it while grease is forced into the core at up to 400 bar, cleaning and coating in one pass. It handles wires from 1 to 50 mm, and the XL version 50 to 90 mm.

faqs.q: Which part numbers does the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator come in?
faqs.a: The complete lubricator in its carry case is IH-FRY-WRL for wire 1 to 50 mm, and IH-FRY-WRL-XL covers wire 50 to 90 mm. Spares are IH-FRY-WRL-GC (groove cleaner), IH-FRY-WRL-SEALS (spare seal set) and IH-FRY-WRL-SCRAPER (scraper plate set), each made for one wire diameter.

faqs.q: How does the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator differ from greasing by hand?
faqs.a: Hand greasing coats the outside of the rope and takes hours on a long wire. Ferryl states the lubricator forces grease into the core and pushes water out, with up to 90% less application time and up to 70% less re-greasing. These are maker figures. See also the [Ferryl Pump Unit](/p/ferryl-pump-unit-wire-rope-lubricator).

faqs.q: How is the correct Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator size chosen?
faqs.a: Choose by wire diameter: the standard lubricator takes wires 1 to 50 mm and the XL takes 50 to 90 mm. Seals, scraper plates and groove cleaners are made for each wire diameter, and the groove cleaner for the wire construction, so tell us the wire size and construction when you order.

faqs.q: What pressure, speed and output does the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator reach?
faqs.a: Ferryl states pressure up to 400 bar, grease output up to 4.5 kg/min and lubrication speed up to 40 m/min. Ferryl measured these with Ferryl 202 Standard grease and the Ferryl Pump Unit, so other pumps and greases may give different results.

faqs.q: Which grease and wire types suit the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator?
faqs.a: The lubricator takes grease from NLGI 0 to 3 and is designed around [Ferryl 202 Standard](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease). Ferryl lists crane, hoist and luffing wires, mooring and towing wires, and ramp wires. The chamber is anodised aluminium alloy with six 1/2 inch female BSP connections.

faqs.q: Does the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator have a published standard or approval?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for the lubricator. The documents that exist are the Ferryl brochure and product information, and we can supply further documents on request. Size and weight are published: 450 mm long and 4.5 kg, with air supply 0 to 10 bar to the pump.

faqs.q: Which products go with the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator?
faqs.a: The lubricator is fed by the [Ferryl Pump Unit](/p/ferryl-pump-unit-wire-rope-lubricator) and designed around [Ferryl 202 Standard grease](/p/ferryl-202-standard-anticorrosive-wire-rope-grease). For other drum pumps, see our [grease and oil barrel pumps](/c/lubrication-barrel-pumps) and the [wire rope lubricators shelf](/c/wire-rope-lubricators).

faqs.q: How does the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator work, and what is in the case?
faqs.a: The wire runs through a sealed chamber filled with grease under pressure. An optional groove cleaner at the entry removes old grease, dirt and debris, Ferryl says up to 90% of it, and scraper plates leave an even outer coat. The case holds the chamber, seals, scraper plates, a spare seal set and ratchet straps.

faqs.q: Where is the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator used?
faqs.a: Ferryl lists the lubricator for crane, hoist and luffing wires, mooring and towing wires, and ramp wires. It suits ships and offshore units that grease long wires on deck, where hand greasing takes hours. See also our guide to [wire rope construction](/blog/wire-rope-construction-explained).

faqs.q: Who makes the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator and where is it made?
faqs.a: The Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. Country of origin is Germany. Ferryl states in its brochure that it was founded in Sweden in 1955.

faqs.q: Is the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator available in stock?
faqs.a: We keep the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address, and we confirm the quote. Include the wire diameter and construction so seals, scrapers and groove cleaner match.
